epic.intent:
## Outcome and scope
Deliver one complete hybrid chat workspace: existing CLI/PTY terminal plus ONE resizable side pane (browser, viewer or agents), bidirectional screenshot/file handoff, authenticated chat-local CLI/MCP pane control, and trustworthy live subagent activity. Existing run/ticket/Kanban authority and human approval boundaries remain unchanged. This is a single delivery sprint, not a sequence of experiments, scaffolds or later caveat sprints.

## Architecture decisions (implementation contract)
- Main owns pane resources, files, authentication and capture. Renderer owns layout/controls and sends bounded geometry via guarded typed IPC. A native browser receives no app preload/bridge. One side-pane slot per chat; hidden chats never leave native views over the active screen.
- Persist only validated per-chat layout and reopenable descriptors. Tokens, grants, socket addresses, WebContents IDs and live process state are never persisted as layout. Restore files by fresh authorization, not by reviving a token; missing temp files show an explicit missing-file state.
- Images are files in the validated chat's private staging directory under system temp, PNG/JPEG only, <=10 MiB and <=8000 pixels/side. Reuse the already-landed attachment intake/path helpers, not the old plan's conditional duplicate parser. Attachments remain durable evidence owned by the existing attachment subsystem; staging cleanup must never delete copied evidence.
- Browser uses a main-owned sandboxed WebContentsView and stable per-folder isolated session partition. Allow only http/https navigations, including localhost; deny app/custom/file schemes, permission grants and downloads. Renderer chrome, dialogs and overlays must not be occluded by the native view.
- Pane control uses the existing command table/authz plus a versioned local pipe/socket. The server derives repository/chat/session scope from a currently valid grant main bound to a live PTY, never from caller-supplied chat IDs. An arbitrary external orchestrator grant is not a desktop-chat grant. Every privileged operation revalidates authorization at execution, not just connection time.
- Capture is an actual rendered-pixels operation, not a DOM mock. Native child views and DIP/device-pixel conversions must be handled. Whole-window capture must include the native browser where shown. Background-chat requests must not silently screenshot the foreground chat or steal focus: a nonvisible pixel surface yields a defined pane_not_visible error; opening records state without switching chats.
- Activity is an observational, versioned provider adapter over actual CLI artifacts. Unknown/unsupported/stale states are visible; no invented tokens, finish status, effort or final report. Provider-derived ticket matches are advisory, never authorization or attempt evidence. Original conditional Codex adapter scope is retained: DM-466 must resolve support truthfully and implement the adapter when usable source is demonstrated, rather than treating a closure note as success.

## Single-sprint execution and standards
- One dependency-ordered sprint and one final human checkpoint. Front-load shared contracts and provider evidence within this sprint; dependency rows are NOT extra sprints or approval stops.
- Preserve the existing standards: no mandatory tests-first and no Fireguard run. Each implementation worker writes/runs the behavioral tests listed in its ticket plus lint/typecheck for changed code; no full-suite, coverage or build sweep per ticket. Do not defer unit coverage of a ticket's risky logic to an unnamed later worker.
- DM-449 owns the end-loaded combined sweeps: current project Definition of Done (lint, typecheck, npm test, coverage, deadcode, build) once on the integrated sprint, followed by actual Electron/packaged native/CLI/security and user-journey checks. Recheck affected failures after repair, not the entire full gate after every worker.
- Every nonoptional work ticket has an explicit acceptance-node covers criterion. Record real commands, environment/provider versions and screenshots/artifacts. Missing external credentials or another required runtime are an unmet gate, not a passed criterion with a caveat. A single sprint does not waive unfinished scope.
- Workers use isolated worktrees for overlapping files; in a shared working tree serialize editing of App/IPC/bootstrap/shared contracts. Preserve unrelated user changes. The orchestrator still independently reviews attempts; only a person approves the final checkpoint.

## Non-goals
No evidence-store replacement, annotation editor, inline terminal image protocol, browser tabs or simultaneous multiple side panes. No SDK migration, executing provider transcript content, provider login bypass, elevated permissions, arbitrary file preview or automatic ticket acceptance.

## Corrected baseline and threat boundary
The image-attachments epic is complete; dm-attachment:, intake/root helpers and production CSP support already exist. xterm already has URL/OSC8/clipboard/grapheme addons; preserve them. Existing TerminalSessions.paste schedules Enter, so it cannot satisfy no-submit image handoff unchanged. chatStore.ts remains persistence owner with chatRecords.ts as facade; both layers participate. Windows named-pipe default ACLs are not a user-exclusive transport guarantee. Viewer roots intentionally retain repository/worktrees, system temp and screenshot eligibility; chat-local control is not a promise that eligible temp files are private between chats. Whole-window agent capture is opt-in, while direct human capture remains available.

## User-directed replanning
Existing Backlog hybrid-workspace epic, not new work or execution. Consolidate saved revision 2 from three sprints/three checkpoints to ONE sprint/one human checkpoint. Preserve all 15 work-ticket IDs/keys, retain DM-449 as sole final acceptance and remove only redundant sprint acceptance nodes DM-456/DM-461. Every work ticket receives source locations, structured references, artifacts, technical choices, failure semantics, behavioral tests, size/effort and final coverage.

## Theory-crafted critical path
Front-loaded independent roots: layout/contracts DM-450, image staging DM-451, authenticated transport DM-457 and provider evidence/model DM-462. Viewer joins layout+staging; paste follows staging; browser follows layout. Image links join viewer+browser occlusion. Commands/capture joins transport+viewer+browser; capture-send joins commands+no-submit insertion. Claude activity joins evidence/model+viewer projection; agents UI follows reader; ticket/card binding follows reader+UI. Codex outcome consumes evidence and common reader/reducer. Documentation joins all completed user-facing branches. Six dependency waves are execution order, NOT six milestones/sprints/approval stops.

## Decisions versus rejected alternatives
- Keep native sandboxed WebContentsView, not iframe/webview or app bridge in hostile content. Counted shared occlusion, registered window identity and generation-bound main geometry own the layering/capture seam.
- Keep file-based screenshot handoff and existing attachment evidence store. Reuse landed intake/protocol patterns; do not duplicate header parser, persist file tokens or broaden raw provider-home access. Immutable bounded file snapshots eliminate reopen-by-path capability drift.
- Introduce separate no-submit insertion because current paste deliberately schedules Enter and may resume a CLI. Do not special-case path text in existing submitted kickoff flows.
- Use authenticated per-instance local transport and current live-grant binding; historical grant IDs, random pipe address or Windows default ACL cannot serve as authority. Strict bounded frames and 20s/25s deadlines reconcile 15s load wait.
- Native whole-window capture must include browser pixels; actual Electron probe selects the strategy but must be followed by correct implementation (dependency-free bitmap composition if necessary). No screenshot replay, DOM capture or accidental foreground capture may satisfy it. Agent whole-window capture is human opt-in per live chat; direct human capture remains available.
- Source-backed adapters and explicit unknown/support/health states replace inferred completion/tokens/parent and first-key ticket ownership. Codex adapter remains conditional on demonstrated usable CLI records, but evidence-backed support resolution is required in DM-466. No additional provider adapters are silently promised.

## Test cadence and runtime prerequisites
Workers own listed behavioral tests and targeted smoke plus lint/typecheck for code; no test-order mandate. DM-449 owns current DoD including npm run coverage once at final integration, then deterministic fixture, security/lifecycle, native/packaged, provider and docs sweeps. No Fireguard grading. Full npm test and coverage both remain because project DoD requires both. Acceptance includes reusable parameterized driver/runbook and per-work-ticket witnesses; no generic test-forwarding/source-text assertions.
Secure Windows and macOS runtime executors/scaling facilities, signed-in authorized Claude for original no-permission-prompt/live-child claim, and isolated fixture profiles before execution. Missing required evidence cannot become a passed criterion with a caveat. Finite load witnesses are bounded tests, not proofs of unlimited scalability. Native ABI/clipboard/composition and provider assumptions remain implementation proof obligations, not present-day verified behavior.

## Parallelism and boundaries
Maximum two workers, isolated worktrees and serialized integration of shared main/bootstrap/App/IPC files; if workers share one checkout, serialize overlapping writes instead. No spurious graph edges solely for merge order. Keep original retry/continue-independent policy and one final human approval; no run starts as part of this planning task. Unrelated dirty process/board edits belong to the user.

## Red-team evidence corrections and limitations
Four read-only orthogonal lenses (code/native lifecycle, contracts/security, SDET/gates, product/activity) inspected saved plan and existing sources. Independently verified: 15 work tickets all lacked references/artifacts; three acceptance nodes had empty bodies, NOT empty criteria. Corrected coordinator suspicion: chatStore.ts remains persistence owner, chatRecords.ts facade. Corrected stale original claims: attachment protocol/intake/CSP landed; xterm already supports URL/OSC8/clipboard/graphemes; blanket Edit-menu interception is not cross-platform fact. Corrected SDET first pass to retain project-required coverage. Local Claude sidechain metadata and Codex Desktop rollout exist; these do not establish current executable version, all lifecycle semantics or terminal Codex parity. No product runtime/tests executed during read-only planning review; validation/readback below verifies the PLAN, not future feature behavior.

## Responsibility and ordering
This is the ONLY acceptance node and ONLY full-gate checkpoint of this single sprint. It implicitly waits for all required work. Review integrated work, implement/reuse a parameterized scratch-profile acceptance driver and execute the actual product; do not substitute fake API echoes, jsdom screenshots, historical replays or injected replacement source. Complete all required checks before submitting the report; failures are fixed and rechecked within this sprint, not moved to a caveat sprint.

## Source locations
- package.json and vitest.config.ts: actual scripts, Node-default unit runner and project coverage configuration.
- src/main/terminals/__fixtures__/agentFixture.mjs and __mocks__/terminalSessionsRig.ts: existing fake/real-CLI seam patterns. Extend the real fixture to advertise bracketed-paste readiness before testing no-submit input; it currently does not. Record raw input without logging DM_SESSION_TOKEN.
- src/main/terminals/ptyHost.real.test.ts: current native tests are macOS-gated, so Windows green alone is not ConPTY proof.
- src/renderer/src/__mocks__/appHarness.tsx and App.terminal.test.tsx: useful unit harnesses, NOT native geometry/clipboard/CSP proof.
- src/test/images.ts: existing header-only fixtures are intake boundaries, NOT displayable-image proof; final fixtures must be real encoded images with independently known colored pixels.
- src/main/desktop/attachmentProtocol.integration.test.ts: response-byte pattern, NOT proof of actual Electron protocol registration.
- src/test/mcpHarness.ts, src/cli/main.test.ts and scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs: existing SDK/CLI process patterns. Some SDK harnesses stub the app API; final pane path must reach the actual app/pipe.
- NEW scripts/smoke-hybrid-workspace.mjs plus docs/verification/hybrid-workspace.md: portable parameterized driver/runbook, following scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs process/JSON approach, never fixed private /tmp paths.

## Tests: end-loaded sweep protocol
1. Record integrated revision/commit, OS/architecture, Node/Electron, provider executable/record versions and isolated profile/repo roots. Run current DoD centrally: npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run coverage; npm run deadcode; npm run build. Both test and coverage are project-required despite overlap. No npm run fireguard grading and no blanket tests-first requirement. Fix failures without relaxing rules/thresholds. Full gate is not repeated after every work ticket; rerun affected failed checks after repairs and keep evidence tied to final tree.
2. Build a deterministic native Electron fixture environment with isolated userData/home/repo/temp, actual PTY, real clipboard and locally served web fixtures. HTTP and trusted HTTPS cover colored marker/title, redirects, popups, downloads, permissions and deliberately unfinished load; no global TLS bypass. Use at least two origins/folders for isolation. Exercise dev and production CSP/custom schemes with real valid PNG/JPEG decoding. Do not consume user's real chats/grants/cookies.
3. Run positive journeys: persist split/layout through switch and app restart; paste/drop/image-link hover+click; browser navigate/history; each pane capture and window composition; Send to agent no-submit; capture->add_attachment->evidence readback surviving staging prune; fixture activity tree/details; confirmed and ambiguous ticket/card links. Confirm exact target pixels/crops and raw PTY input, not only filenames/callbacks.
4. Run trust/lifecycle sweeps with allowed positive controls reaching each same sink: hostile page cannot access Node/preload/app IPC or dm-pane; redirects/popups cannot bypass scheme policy; file outside ALL allowed roots, junction/replace/token expiry; raw pipe missing/wrong/revoked/cross-instance/cross-generation grants, fragmented/oversized frames and disconnect; no raw tokens in error/log/projection. Capture while another chat/overlay is selected or target mutates must refuse without cross-chat pixels/late file. Verify per-chat whole-window agent opt-in. Nested menu/dialog/sign-in tests require screenshot AND click-interception observation.
5. Quantify finite witnesses: activity 20 complete appends 100ms apart, each visible <=2000ms after writer completion, including forced polling fallback; partial line has no event until complete, then same bound. Replay 2100 events: retained <=2000, preserved totals, duplicate-free paging and same replay totals after restart. Record unknown/provider lag separately. Twenty open/close/switch cycles end with no leaked owned views/watchers/PTY descendants/socket. Input observer runs >=3 seconds beyond settled image insertion and beyond every queued timer: no unsolicited CR/LF/submit. Enforce shared 15s load,20s server,25s client budgets (+1s measurement tolerance) and no late operation after cancellation. Send 64KiB+1 unterminated request alongside ten valid clients; reject bounded input while valid clients complete within their deadlines.
6. Native/packaged matrix: actual Windows ConPTY and macOS PTY, existing Electron ABI/native artifact preparation, dev+production browser/overlay/capture. Run npm run package:win once in final stage (its internal build is expected), exercise installed and portable production artifacts including built CLI/MCP resources. macOS executor runs package:mac and actual app. Verify 1x plus non-1x OS scaling, including Windows 150/200% and macOS Retina where available; zoom-only/jsdom simulation is not OS-scale proof. Window capture must show both host and child-browser markers at correct location; terminal/viewer crops exclude unrelated surfaces. Recheck restart revokes capabilities without losing layout. Required platform unavailable means unmet final evidence, not passed with a caveat.
7. Real provider claims: always run sanitized deterministic Claude/Codex support fixtures. Required live Claude verification uses available signed-in authorized executable to read a pasted known image without permission prompt and spawn a known child/report; settings serialization alone does not prove it. Record version and observations without secrets. Conditional Codex outcome follows DM-466: usable sources require adapter proof; otherwise specific supported-state evidence. Missing provider auth is unverified, not proof of unsupported format or a successful live criterion. Secure these prerequisites before run; do not silently shrink required Claude scope.
8. Read docs examples against actual CLI/MCP schema/discovery and execute in scratch profile. Produce coverage matrix mapping every work ticket to its final witness, per-platform result, screenshots (real image attachments where requested), command outputs and limits. Never call an unexecuted case passed. Submit independent criterion evidence, one final sprint report and retrospective; only the person approves final checkpoint.

## Expected artifacts and limits
Checked-in parameterized acceptance driver/runbook; sanitized real encoded fixtures; final machine-readable sweep result/measurements; native screenshots and attachment IDs; command logs without secrets; provider/platform support evidence and per-ticket matrix. The finite stress witnesses do not prove unlimited load/exhaustive races. Do not claim cross-platform/permission/composition success from unit tests or fixture availability alone. Temporary probes are removed or folded into the reusable driver, not left as scaffolding.

## Sizing
Large: this node verifies the one pinned combined increment across native surface, transport and provider seams; it cannot be replaced by independently passing per-ticket mocks. It owns the final integration evidence once.
